# Kenmerken van de gebruikte omgeving

## Platform

```{r session-info, results = "asis", echo=FALSE}
si <- devtools::session_info()
p <- si$platform %>%
  do.call(what = "c")
sprintf("- **%s**:\n %s\n", names(p), p) %>%
  cat()
```

## R packages

```{r results = "asis", echo=FALSE}
si$packages %>%
    as_tibble %>%
    select(package, loadedversion, date, source) %>%
pander::pandoc.table(caption = "(\\#tab:sessioninfo)Loaded R packages",
                     split.table = Inf)
```


## Data version

```{r results = "asis", echo=FALSE}
nonpublicrepo_tags <- git2r::tags(nonpublicrepo)
data_labels <- 
    c(watinalocs_tag = 
          nonpublicrepo_tags %>% 
          names %>% 
          str_subset("watinalocs") %>% 
          .[1],
      extlocs_tag = 
          nonpublicrepo_tags %>% 
          names %>% 
          str_subset("extlocs") %>% 
          .[1],
      watinadata_tag = 
          nonpublicrepo_tags %>% 
          names %>% 
          str_subset("watinadata") %>% 
          .[1],
      gwanalysisdata_tag = 
          nonpublicrepo_tags %>% 
          names %>% 
          str_subset("gwanalysisdata") %>% 
          .[1]
    )
sprintf("- **%s**:\n `%s`\n", names(data_labels), data_labels) %>%
  cat()
```
